items.title: Google Will Make AI Agents Use Its MCP Servers. The Gmail One Can't Send Email
items.summary_zh: Google 计划通过 MCP (Model Context Protocol) 标准集成 AI Agent 服务，目前 Gmail MCP Server 仅支持读取邮件，暂不支持发送功能。
items.why_zh: Agent 架构设计技能点。学习如何利用 MCP 标准化协议解耦 Agent 与外部工具的交互接口，提升系统集成灵活性与安全性。

items.title: Certify What You Plant: Shortcut-Free Proof Depth in Logical Reasoning Data
items.summary: arXiv:2611.33303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Procedurally generated logic problems are used to both evaluate and train reasoning in language models. Their difficulty is usually set by planting a proof, that is, by sampling a proof of the desired depth and stating its premises as the problem. However, a planted proof is only one possible proof. A problem can also have shorter proofs, or several unrelated ones, and its stated depth then overstates what solving it requires. We measure what a pro
items.summary_zh: 研究提出一种确保逻辑推理数据集中不存在“捷径”的方法，通过验证植入证明的唯一性，防止模型通过非逻辑路径获得正确答案。
items.why_zh: 模型评估与数据工程技能点。学习如何通过控制推理深度与逻辑路径唯一性，构建高质量的推理基准测试集，避免模型过拟合捷径。

items.title: Extraneous Cognitive Load in Large Language Models
items.summary: arXiv:2611.33197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cognitive Load Theory (CLT) shows that human problem-solving is affected by both intrinsic load, arising from task difficulty, and extraneous load, arising from how task information is presented. Large language models (LLMs) show analogous effects: presentation alone can affect model performance, but these effects have not yet been systematically isolated from task difficulty. To address this gap, we introduce CogLoadBench, a controlled benchmark t
items.summary_zh: 引入认知负荷理论 (CLT) 分析 LLM，指出任务信息的呈现方式会产生无关认知负荷，从而显著影响模型的推理与执行性能。
items.why_zh: Prompt Engineering 与上下文优化技能点。学习通过优化输入信息的结构化呈现方式，降低模型的无关认知负荷，提升复杂任务的执行准确率。

items.title: opensetlabs/openset-llm
items.summary: Fast local LLM inference on plain CPUs. No GPU, 8 GB of RAM. OpenAI-compatible server.
items.summary_zh: OpenSet LLM 提供一种在仅有 8GB 内存的 CPU 环境下实现快速本地推理的方案，并兼容 OpenAI API 接口。
items.why_zh: 边缘计算与模型部署技能点。学习在资源受限环境下通过量化或高效推理引擎实现本地化部署，降低 Agent 运行的硬件门槛。

items.title: Lukcla3889/postman-agent
items.summary: Postman Agent for Windows 10/11. Runs API requests and collections on your local machine, letting you send calls to localhost, inspect responses and debug endpoints without leaving the desktop.
items.summary_zh: Postman Agent 允许在本地机器运行 API 请求与集合，支持直接调用 localhost 接口并进行调试。
items.why_zh: Agent 开发与调试技能点。学习如何构建本地代理以打通云端 Agent 与本地开发环境的通信，解决内网穿透与本地接口调试难题。

items.title: AMD-specific fork of llama.cpp
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp 发布 AMD 专用分支，针对 AMD GPU 架构优化了推理性能与硬件兼容性。
items.why_zh: 高性能计算与推理优化技能点。学习针对不同硬件后端（如 ROCm）进行算子优化与内存管理，提升模型在非 NVIDIA 硬件上的推理吞吐量。

items.title: ersinkoc/phonebox
items.summary: Turn an old Android phone into a customizable desk panel and touch control deck for Windows, Linux and macOS. 124 widgets and 30 templates for system stats, AI coding, media and automation, in 13 languages. USB or paired Wi-Fi. No cloud required.
items.summary_zh: Phonebox 将旧 Android 手机转化为跨平台桌面控制面板，支持 124 个自定义小组件，通过 USB 或 Wi-Fi 实现本地化 AI 辅助与自动化控制。
items.why_zh: 属于边缘计算与人机交互领域，可学习如何通过本地协议实现低延迟的设备间通信，在构建 Agent 物理控制接口时具有参考价值。

items.title: cc4w/adobe-firefly-image-generator
items.summary: Adobe Firefly Image Generator: Professional Image Creation
items.summary_zh: Adobe Firefly Image Generator 提供专业级图像生成能力，支持通过 API 集成实现高质量的 AI 图像创作工作流。
items.why_zh: 属于多模态生成式 AI 应用开发，学习如何调用商业化视觉模型 API 并将其集成到生产环境，掌握图像生成任务的工程化封装。

items.title: Sakana AI Releases Namazu Small, a 30B Model Built on Nemotron 3 Nano
items.summary: Sakana AI released Sakana Namazu Small, a 30B-A3B reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano. It averages 60.1 across 25 benchmarks, ahead of the 120B Nemotron 3 Super at 56.2. The post Sakana AI Releases Namazu Small, a 30B Model Built on Nemotron 3 Nano appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Sakana AI 发布 Namazu Small，这是一款基于 NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 构建的 30B 规模推理模型，在 25 项基准测试中表现优于 120B 模型。
items.why_zh: 属于模型压缩与推理优化领域，学习如何通过架构创新（如 MoE 或高效参数组合）在较小参数规模下实现超越大模型的推理性能。

items.title: JustRUA ! 精简 harness框架让 GPT-6 在 RoboDojo 上从 29.7 分到 50.3 分
items.summary: 不训练策略，不用自我改进循环，也不针对任务调参，GPT-6 Astra 操控机械臂能做到什么程度？
items.summary_zh: 通过精简 harness 框架，在不进行策略训练、自我改进或任务调参的情况下，显著提升了 GPT-6 Astra 在 RoboDojo 机械臂任务中的性能表现。
items.why_zh: 属于机器人具身智能领域，学习如何通过优化评估框架与任务交互逻辑，在不改变模型权重的前提下提升 Agent 在复杂环境中的执行效率。

items.title: Inkling 2 Mini - The Qwen 27B Killer?
items.summary: In this video I look at Thinking Labs's new local looped transformer Inkling 2 Mini a 26B MoE model that many are Blog: https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/ HF: https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini 2nd Channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUF7WtR4JpVbQqcQGrLeADw Twitter: https://x.com/Sam_Witteveen 🕵️ Interested in building LLM Agents? Fill out the form below Building LLM Agents Form: https://drp.li/dIMes 👨‍💻Github: https://github.com/samwit/llm-tutorials ⏱️Tim…
items.summary_zh: Thinking Labs 发布 Inkling 2 Mini，这是一款 26B 参数的 MoE 架构循环 Transformer 模型，旨在挑战 Qwen 27B 的性能表现。
items.why_zh: 属于模型架构设计领域，学习 MoE 架构在本地化部署中的资源分配策略，以及循环 Transformer 如何在保持模型轻量化的同时提升推理能力。

items.title: DeepMind’s New AI Just Changed The AI Race
items.summary: ❤️ Check out Lambda here and sign up for their GPU Cloud: https://lambda.com/papers 📝 The security report is available here: https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/gemini/gemini_4_neon_safety_report.pdf Sources: - https://x.com/PromptLLM/status/2124894800654504419 - https://x.com/thebuggeddev/status/2123170821250400282 - https://x.com/ai_for_success/status/2123467103110078747 - https://x.com/thtbee_/status/2123843882937155607 - https://x.com/crtvTeknologist/status/2123175626039304496 - ht…
items.summary_zh: DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，并同步披露了相关的安全性评估报告，旨在通过技术迭代重塑 AI 竞赛格局。
items.why_zh: 属于 AI 安全与对齐领域，学习如何构建大规模模型的安全性评估框架，以及在模型发布过程中如何通过报告量化模型的鲁棒性与风险。

items.title: Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache
items.summary: Tencent open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs. Each draft layer reuses the target's KV cache and top-k indexer picks, adding no draft KV memory and lifting 64K serving throughput by up to 81%. The post Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 腾讯开源 DFly2，这是一种针对稀疏注意力 LLM 的投机采样模型，通过复用目标模型的 KV Cache 和 Top-k 索引，在不增加额外内存开销的情况下，将 64K 上下文吞吐量提升至多 81%。
items.why_zh: 属于 LLM 推理加速优化领域。学习如何通过复用 KV Cache 减少投机采样中的显存占用，掌握提升长文本推理吞吐量的工程实现路径。

items.title: Hermes Agent just leveled up...
items.summary: Get your own always-on Hermes Agent VPS on Hostinger: https://hostinger.com/hermeswesroth Use coupon code WESROTH at checkout for an extra discount on your VPS plan. (Hostinger sponsored the setup segment of this video.) Most AI tools stop working the second you close your laptop. In this video, I walk through setting up Hermes Agent, an open-source 24/7 AI agent framework by Nous Research, on a Hostinger VPS so it can run business automations, audit documents, connect to Telegram, and execute s…
items.summary_zh: Nous Research 开源的 Hermes Agent 框架支持在 VPS 上 24/7 持续运行，实现 AI Agent 的全天候自主任务处理与环境交互。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 部署与架构领域。学习如何将 Agent 框架从本地环境迁移至云端服务器，掌握实现 Agent 长期运行与状态持久化的工程化部署方案。

dups.title: w01fb0ss/PiBot
dups.summary: Open-source, local-first AI agent team for your desktop: multi-agent group chats, computer use, browser, MCP, routines and approvals. macOS, Windows, Linux + Android. Built on pi.
dups.summary_zh: PiBot 是一个支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Android 的本地优先 AI 智能体框架，集成了多智能体群聊、计算机操作、浏览器控制及 MCP 协议。
dups.why_zh: 属于端侧 Agent 开发，可学习如何构建跨平台本地 Agent 架构，以及如何集成 MCP 协议实现多工具协同。

dups.title: mdiri-ai/SoduWork
dups.summary: The AI-native engine for teams and their agents. Multi-harness, multi-agent, self-hosted.
dups.summary_zh: SoduWork 是一个支持多 Agent 协作、多任务编排且可自托管的 AI 原生引擎，旨在为团队提供统一的 Agent 运行与管理基础设施。
dups.why_zh: 属于 Agent 编排与系统架构领域。可复用做法：学习如何设计多 Agent 协作的通信协议与任务调度机制，实现复杂业务流程的自动化闭环。

dups.title: Feature-Based Explainability of Transformer Scoring Models: A Fidelity-First Framework for Automated Writing Assessment
dups.summary: arXiv:2611.33175v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transformer-based automated writing scoring models can achieve strong agreement with human scores while providing limited transparency into the response characteristics associated with their predictions. This study evaluated a feature-based post-hoc explanation approach in which explanatory fidelity was established before feature importance was interpreted. English Language Arts responses from three writing prompts in Grades 6 and 8 were analyzed,
dups.summary_zh: 提出一种基于特征的 Transformer 自动写作评分模型可解释性框架，通过优先保证解释忠实度来提升模型预测的透明度。
dups.why_zh: 模型可解释性与评估指标设计。学习如何通过后验解释方法量化特征重要性，适用于需要模型审计与决策归因的 AI 系统开发。

dups.title: Verified experience improves materials prediction with large language models
dups.summary: arXiv:2611.33195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials discovery is an iterative loop: experiments and calculations verify predictions, and each outcome can inform the next. Yet most predictors are specialized single-task models fixed after training. Large language models have recently emerged as predictors across heterogeneous tasks but generally underperform specialized models, and retrieval-augmented variants discard their own outcomes. Benchmarks also score queries in isolation, leaving i
dups.summary_zh: 引入验证经验反馈机制提升 LLM 在材料科学预测任务中的性能，通过检索增强与迭代循环弥补通用模型与专用模型的差距。
dups.why_zh: RAG 与闭环反馈系统。学习如何将实验验证数据作为动态上下文注入 LLM，解决垂类领域模型在异构任务中表现不佳的问题。

dups.title: yzsind/mydb
dups.summary: A high-performance MySQL-compatible database for HTAP and AI agents Mixed transactional and analytical workloads, with native AI retrieval.
dups.summary_zh: 开源一款兼容 MySQL 的高性能 HTAP 数据库，内置原生 AI 检索功能，专为混合事务与分析负载及 AI Agent 应用设计。
dups.why_zh: AI 基础设施与数据工程。了解如何将向量检索与传统数据库架构深度集成，优化 Agent 在处理大规模结构化数据时的响应效率。

dups.title: XinaTian/MROffice
dups.summary: MR Office — the open-source editors of the AI office suite closest to Microsoft Office: documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF and code in the browser. Copilot in every editor edits real Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with you; an MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex create and edit them; embed it in your app with one line.
dups.summary_zh: MROffice 是一个开源 AI 办公套件，支持在浏览器中编辑 Word、Excel、PPT 及代码，并提供 MCP 服务供 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 模型直接操作文档。
dups.why_zh: 掌握 MCP 协议在复杂应用场景的落地，学习如何通过 MCP 将 AI 能力集成到传统文档编辑工作流中，提升 Agent 对结构化数据的操控能力。
